list.item: Unit-Based Learning: Each section of the course is organized into units, with each focusing on a specific topic.

Interactive Quizzes: Each section comes with a quiz to test you on what you've learned. No need to worry! Quiz scores are not saved. You can progress regardless of quiz scores. Mistakes are welcome and corrections are shown to help you learn.
Unlock Units: To progress to the next unit, you'll need to complete the quiz for the unit you're currently on.

content.header: Welcome to the Tagalog Learning Tutorial!
content.text: In this tutorial, you will learn basic Tagalog vocabulary, pronouns, and sentence structures.
This course is designed to help you get familiar with basic Tagalog expressions for everyday conversations.
The course is divided into multiple lessons, focusing on:
